evals.prompt: Ask: should we use postgres or sqlite for the local dev database?
evals.description: Happy path: question does not exist yet — it should be recorded as open with a unique timestamp ID.
evals.expected_output: The skill appends a new question entry to questions.mem with status=open and a valid ISO8601 id, then prints 'Question recorded: ...'

assertions.text: questions.mem contains a line with '+question:' and 'status=open' and 'text=should we use postgres or sqlite for the local dev database'
The appended line contains an 'id=' field that matches the ISO8601 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ
The agent prints a confirmation message containing the question text

evals.prompt: Ask: should we use postgres or sqlite for the local dev database?
evals.description: Dedup path: an open question with the same text already exists in questions.mem — the skill must skip appending and inform the user.
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-ask-1/.memplan/memory && echo '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +question:id=~2026-05-28T09:00Z,text=should we use postgres or sqlite for the local dev database,status=open' > /tmp/eval-ask-1/.memplan/memory/questions.mem
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the existing open question and prints 'Already recorded (open): ...' without appending any new line to questions.mem.

assertions.text: questions.mem contains exactly one line matching 'status=open' and the question text after the skill runs
The agent prints a message indicating the question is already recorded as open

evals.prompt: Ask: should we use postgres or sqlite for the local dev database?
evals.description: Closed-question does not block new ask: the same text exists but with status=answered — the skill must record a fresh open question.
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-ask-2/.memplan/memory && echo '~2026-05-20T10:00Z +question:id=~2026-05-20T10:00Z,text=should we use postgres or sqlite for the local dev database,status=answered' > /tmp/eval-ask-2/.memplan/memory/questions.mem
evals.expected_output: The skill does not treat the closed question as a duplicate. It appends a new question entry with status=open and confirms to the user.

assertions.text: questions.mem contains a new line with 'status=open' and the question text after the skill runs
The original 'status=answered' line is still present in questions.mem (not removed or overwritten)
The agent prints a confirmation message containing the question text, not a skip/already-recorded message

evals.prompt: Ask: what is the preferred commit format for this project?
evals.description: New question when questions.mem does not yet exist — the skill must handle the missing file gracefully and still record the question.
evals.expected_output: The skill handles a missing questions.mem without error, creates/appends the file via the CLI, and confirms the question was recorded.

assertions.text: After the skill runs, questions.mem exists and contains a line with 'status=open' and the question text
The agent does not report an error or abort due to questions.mem not existing
